#+title: habshe-emacs — editing behavior
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

How text gets edited: typing replaces the active selection,
kill/copy commands fall back to the whole current line when no
region is active, and a dedicated command deletes lines outright
— deleted, not cut.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-editing.el"
  ;;; my-editing.el --- GENERATED from org/editing.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Selection replacement, whole-line kill/copy, hard
  ;;; line deletion.

  (defgroup my-editing nil
    "Editing behavior for my Emacs configuration.")

  ;; Typing or yanking over an active selection deletes it first.
  (delete-selection-mode 1)

  ;; C-w, M-w, comment-dwim etc. operate on the current real line when
  ;; no region is active. whole-line-or-region is an external package;
  ;; degrade gracefully if the install pass could not run (e.g. no
  ;; network on first boot) rather than break all of init.
  (when (require 'whole-line-or-region nil t)
    (whole-line-or-region-global-mode 1))

  (defun my-editing-delete-line (&optional arg)
    "Delete ARG lines starting at point, without the kill ring.
Unlike `kill-whole-line', the text is gone for good: it never
enters the kill ring and cannot be yanked back. Point is left at
the start of the line following the deleted text."
    (interactive "p")
    (delete-region (line-beginning-position)
                   (save-excursion
                     (forward-line (or arg 1))
                     (point))))

  (defun my-editing-delete-to-beginning-of-line ()
    "Delete from point to the beginning of the line, without the kill ring.
The deleted text cannot be yanked back."
    (interactive)
    (delete-region (line-beginning-position) (point)))

  (defun my-editing-delete-to-end-of-line ()
    "Delete from point to the end of the line, without the kill ring.
Covers the same span as `kill-line' would, but the text is gone for
good and cannot be yanked back."
    (interactive)
    (delete-region (point) (line-end-position)))

  (provide 'my-editing)
#+end_src
